+import click
+
+
+def test_help_cache_tracks_context_spellings():
+    command = click.Command("tool")
+    first_ctx = click.Context(command, help_option_names=["-h", "--help"])
+    first = command.get_help_option(first_ctx)
+    assert first is not None
+    assert first.opts == ["-h", "--help"]
+    assert command.get_help_option(first_ctx) is first
+
+    second_ctx = click.Context(
+        command, help_option_names=["--assist", "-a", "--assist"]
+    )
+    second = command.get_help_option(second_ctx)
+    assert second is not None
+    assert second is not first
+    assert second.opts == ["--assist", "-a"]
+    assert first.opts == ["-h", "--help"]
+    equivalent_ctx = click.Context(
+        command, help_option_names=["--assist", "-a"], terminal_width=100
+    )
+    assert command.get_help_option(equivalent_ctx) is second
+    assert command.get_params(equivalent_ctx)[-1] is second
+
+
+def test_help_cache_tracks_order():
+    command = click.Command("tool")
+    first_ctx = click.Context(command, help_option_names=["-h", "--help"])
+    first = command.get_help_option(first_ctx)
+    second_ctx = click.Context(command, help_option_names=["--help", "-h"])
+    second = command.get_help_option(second_ctx)
+    assert first is not None and second is not None
+    assert second is not first
+    assert first.opts == ["-h", "--help"]
+    assert second.opts == ["--help", "-h"]
+
+
+def test_help_cache_tracks_user_option_conflicts():
+    command = click.Command(
+        "tool", params=[click.Option(["--enabled/--disabled"])]
+    )
+    ctx = click.Context(
+        command,
+        help_option_names=["--enabled", "--disabled", "--assist", "--more"],
+    )
+    first = command.get_help_option(ctx)
+    assert first is not None
+    assert first.opts == ["--assist", "--more"]
+    command.params.append(click.Option(["--assist"]))
+    second = command.get_help_option(ctx)
+    assert second is not None
+    assert second is not first
+    assert second.opts == ["--more"]
+    assert first.opts == ["--assist", "--more"]
+    assert command.get_help_option(ctx) is second
+    command.add_help_option = False
+    assert command.get_help_option(ctx) is None
+    command.add_help_option = True
+    assert command.get_help_option(ctx) is second
+    empty_ctx = click.Context(command, help_option_names=[])
+    assert command.get_help_option(empty_ctx) is None
+
+
+def test_refreshed_help_spelling_is_registered(runner):
+    command = click.Command("tool", help="Tool help.")
+    old_ctx = click.Context(command, help_option_names=["--help"])
+    old_option = command.get_help_option(old_ctx)
+    result = runner.invoke(
+        command, ["--assist"], help_option_names=["--assist"]
+    )
+    assert result.exit_code == 0
+    assert "Tool help." in result.output
+    assert "--assist" in result.output
+    assert old_option is not None
+    assert old_option.opts == ["--help"]
